ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface, with high-intensity (white) pixel values limited to water spray and barnacle colonization.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp axial convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration pattern consisting of irregular triangular pixel-peaks and valleys along the posterior boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex lateral lobe margins exhibiting a steep vertical upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive epibiotic colonization (barnacles) concentrated at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
